contact.basis: Original northern crest approach fixed before terrain/geometry. ModelY0is crest-bank datum, not river water/toe level; dam descends approximately128m.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native Kariba dam frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.9.375m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact gorge/crest/toe classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
